bayesian_summary.moe_notes: Kasagi et al. report typical uncertainty in Q_ex ~0.08 W (1σ) for radiant spectral calorimetry (JCMNS 41 / arXiv:2509.13847). EMP only; does not close EQ-OPEN-YIELD-01 or prove LENR.
bayesian_summary.honesty: discovery_grade_eligible is an analytics flag only (signed S_heat≥5 with literature_reported measurement-specific σ_Q, verified Q↔σ pairing, and non-seed Q). Instrument precision/floor, unverified pairings, and seed-scale Q stay exploratory. It does not set lenr_proved, does not close EQ-OPEN-*, and does not raise claim_tier. Oracle B null_excess_falsified uses exploratory SNR≥3, distinct from this discovery-grade bar.
